own_scenes.desc: Barry Weiss, hijo del dueño de Old Town Records, fue el primer empleado en Estados Unidos del sello londinense de Clive Calder, distribuido por Arista, que veía el rap como discos de novedad. Con Whodini primero y Ann Carli después, Jive levantó un imperio con lo que las multinacionales ignoraban: DJ Jazzy Jeff & the Fresh Prince, Boogie Down Productions, A Tribe Called Quest, Too $hort o Schoolly D. Carli dirigió los vídeos para que tuvieran algo que ver con la cultura.

refs.q: We saw the fact that we had a competitive edge because the major labels were nowhere near this.
refs.para: Barry Weiss (president, Jive Records): We saw the fact that we had a competitive edge because the major labels were nowhere near this. The price of entry was not crazy, and we were an independent label trying to hit the ball where they ain’t, so to speak.
